patchouli.chaosworld.entry.modpack_overv: $(#FFAA00)Chaos World$(#000000) is a large modpack.$(br)$(br)Here, you will experience:$(li)Deeply customized tech production lines$(li)Unique custom items and machines$(li)Challenging progression paths
$(l)Main Mods:$(l)$(li)Applied Energistics 2 (AE2)$(li)ProjectE$(br)$(br)Browse the left sidebar for more content.
